rules.new_topic: Owner only. Add when >=2 subscribers, recurring, and done_means is nameable. No mid-turn invention.
rules.mandate: Publish is part of done for catalog topics. Audit jsonl vs reality and backfill misses.
rules.dms: After publish, DM subscribers listed on the topic. Bus is source of truth; DMs are best-effort push.

task.done.description: A named work item finished with a receipt
task.done.done_means: Subscribers pulled state/board and advanced their lane

task.blocked.description: Work item parked until a named unblock
task.blocked.done_means: Open parks readable via busctl state parks; workers skip reopen while status=open
